change: CUDA device support: models/base.py accepts cuda, isolates the CUDA RNG in rng_scope and checkpoints it as rng_cuda

src/embodied_jepa/models/base.py.why_it_matters: VisualModel.implementation_sha256 digests base.py; VisualModel.load refuses a checkpoint whose digest differs

src/embodied_jepa/models/sensor.py.why_it_matters: SensorWorldModel's implementation_sha256 digests it (its backend module) and its source_revision is its sha256; sensor_wm checkpoints are already covered by the base.py rule

invalidated_at_head.rule: every checkpoint loaded through VisualModel.load (native_jepa, leworldmodel, sensor_wm, jepa_wms, and the frozen-encoder and frozen-token variants), and every ClonedPolicy checkpoint whose feature source is such a model, written at or before last_compatible_revision

named.checkpoints/task054-wm-v4/leworldmodel_b: TASK-054 E0 (implementation_sha256 4ad0a6856d847aaf724daba5e721c078ee599658d4733357ab8703eccbb15a92); the frozen feature source of TASK-056 and TASK-057
named.checkpoints/task056-policy-v1/: TASK-056 ClonedPolicy arms built on E0

invalidated_at_head.not_affected: TASK-067 and TASK-071 policy checkpoints (first_policy_model.PolicyNet and first_policy_v2_model, plain torch modules that do not go through VisualModel.load), and every result already recorded in a results document or manifest

how_to_load_them: check out last_compatible_revision (or the protocol's own recorded revision) and load there; a later source revision is never treated as checkpoint-compatible (docs/SETUP.md)
guard_tests_rule: for base.py the guard tests check that each protocol's pin equals sha256_before here (the bytes those checkpoints were written against), and that base.py at HEAD equals sha256_after, so the next edit to base.py fails them again and has to be recorded; every other pinned file is still compared at HEAD
owner_ruling: T72-R1 (2026-09-28T13:15Z, orchestrator for the owner): Accepted. Enabling CUDA in models/base.py and models/sensor.py is required for the product goal (LeWM training on the RTX 5080). World-model checkpoints written at or before 9e23ced remain valid evidence and load only at their recorded revision; no recorded result changes. The next edit to either file needs its own recorded retirement.

other_pinned_files_changed.note: changed by TASK-072 and pinned by closed protocols' manifests; not part of any checkpoint's implementation hash, and no guard test protects them. Those protocols re-run only at their recorded revisions.
